## Frequently asked questions

Some of the most frequently asked questions.

How does the Automation & ATS Agent work?

This Agent streamlines the interview and assessment process, managing multiple rounds of evaluation, coordinating with interviewers, automating feedback collection, and integrating with your ATS.

Does Talowiz integrate with my existing ATS?

Yes, Talowiz integrates seamlessly with most existing ATS platforms to ensure real-time tracking and automation.

Is there a need of other ATS to manage our entire Applicant Tracking ?

Talowiz Automation and ATS Agent has all major functionalities that an ATS provides. A lot of our clients are able to manage their entire recruitment without any additional ATS
